I am a current graduate student at the University of Maryland, College Park studying M.S. in Machine Learning. I excpect to graduate in December 2025. 

I have obtained an undergraduate degree in Data Science at the University of Pittsburgh in April 2024.

My most recent work experience is working as a Data Scientist Intern at General Motors (GM) where I created a Product Engagement Score for various OnStar products (Remote, Wi-Fi, SuperCruise, etc.) on GM vehicles. I used that developed statisical score to be a feature in my Machine Learning algorithms (classification trees, regression, and unsuperised models) to derive insights on customer retention and acquisition. Then, I delivered my results and findings to various cross-functional stakeholders such as marketing, sales, finance, and engineering.
